import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const systemCi = true;
test('base', { skip: !systemCi && 'needs systemd' }, (t) => { t.plan(1); t.assert.ok(true); });
test('unit states, two ways', async (t) => {
  await t.test('the parser reads a state line', () => { assert.equal('active'.length, 6); });
  if (process.env.FIXTURE_NEVER) {
    await t.test('the real service manager answers', () => {
      spawnSync('systemctl', ['--version']);
      assert.fail('the systemd assertions ran');
    });
  }
});
